channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: New York Harbor boat capsizes near Statue of Liberty, killing mother and child; operator charged
item.description: Twelve people were rescued from the water before police arrived at the scene, according to the Coast Guard. Police divers later found the 27-year-old woman and her infant daughter in the water.

item.title: Salmonella scare: USDA alerts consumers over meat, poultry products containing recalled jalapeños
item.description: The alert follows a recall of fresh jalapeños from Sinaloa, Mexico, distributed by Coast Citrus Distributors. Federal health agencies are investigating a multistate outbreak of Salmonella Javiana infections linked to the peppers.

item.title: Trump signals shift away from new Iran strikes, says US is ‘low-keying it’
item.description: The comments mark a notable shift in tone after Trump repeatedly threatened to launch additional attacks on Iran over the past week.

item.title: ‘Mujhe chaiye peace’: Viral video shows why Indians are moving to Germany over US
item.description: While the US continues to kindle the “American Dream” for millions, many Indians are increasingly prefering Europe for its higher quality of life and better long-term residency options.

item.title: Chandipura virus: What is it, how does it spread, symptoms and ways to prevent infection
item.description: Chandipura virus, spread mainly by infected sandflies, can cause acute encephalitis, especially in children. Here’s what to know about its symptoms, transmission, risks and prevention amid the latest Gujarat-Rajasthan outbreak.

item.title: Mamata Banerjee faces ‘Chor’ chant, mud-hurling protest in Kolkata: ‘Could've been killed’; BJP refutes role in ‘attack’
item.description: BJP state president Samik Bhattacharya rejected the TMC’s allegations that his party was involved in the incident and condemned the reported stone-pelting targeting Banerjee’s vehicle.

item.title: Iran President Pezeshkian meets Mojtaba Khamenei as reports emerge over Supreme Leader's ‘extremely critical’ health
item.description: The Masoud Pezeshkian-Mojtaba Khamenei talks focused on a range of issues, including people's livelihood, military developments and the economic challenges facing Iran.

item.title: Trump posts ‘vandalism’ photos of Reflecting Pool, demands US prosecutor Pirro revisit case
item.description: The photographs come amid Trump’s renewed criticism of Washington’s top federal prosecutor after her office dropped criminal charges against a former Olympian accused of damaging the newly renovated Reflecting Pool.

item.title: Centre extends ED Director Rahul Navin's tenure by one year till August 2027
item.description: A 1993-batch Indian Revenue Service officer of the Income Tax cadre, 59-year-old Navin has been leading the federal anti-money laundering agency as its chief since September 2023.

item.title: What has Jharkhand govt promised protesting students? Key demands addressed, CBI probe remains sticking point
item.description: Jharkhand govt has agreed to cancel the 14th JPSC exam, probe irregularities and set up fast-track courts and an expert panel. Students, however, remain firm on their demand for a CBI probe into JSSC-CGL.

item.title: Moving to NYC? Indian woman shares how to navigate $5,000 rent, groceries, lifestyle & more
item.description: Trish shared that living in New York on a budget is possible with the right strategy, drawing on her past mistakes to help others navigate the city's costly landscape.

item.title: Trump prepares to declare Iran war victory if Hormuz reopens, willing to walk away without nuclear deal: Report
item.description: Trump is preparing to declare victory in the Iran war if Tehran reopens the Strait of Hormuz and is privately willing to walk away without a nuclear deal as Iran raises tough demands.

item.title: RG Kar rape-murder case: CM Suvendu Adhikari orders fresh probe after Ratna Debnath's request
item.description: West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari said the decision was taken following a request from the victim’s mother Ratna Debnath, who is currently a BJP MLA. He alleged that the police had failed to discharge their responsibilities properly in connection with the case.

item.title: IMD warns of heavy rain across north, central India; east to see more showers
item.description: A low-pressure area over the Bay of Bengal is likely to boost rainfall across eastern states from 13 August, while parts of the North-East and Uttarakhand face a flash-flood risk.

item.title: Russia eyes rail link to India as Strait of Hormuz disruptions threaten trade
item.description: The proposal could create an overland freight corridor connecting Russia with India through a network of countries including Turkmenistan, Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan.

item.title: Daniel Kinahan: Who is the Irish crime boss extradited from Dubai to Dublin?
item.description: Kinahan is an Irishman alleged by US and European authorities to be a senior leader of the Kinahan Organised Crime Group, a powerful transnational criminal network linked to drug trafficking, money laundering and violent crime.

item.title: Money spent in Australia ‘doesn't have ₹67 magic’— Indian man shares reality of $100,000 salary
item.description: The Indian man explained that while a $100,000 salary looks very different when converted into Indian rupees, the money spent on taxes, rent and everyday expenses is in AUD.

item.title: Who is Sadie Sink’s Jean Grey? Meet the mutant at the heart of Spider-Man: Brand New Day
item.description: Sadie Sink has confirmed she plays Jean Grey in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, introducing a new MCU version of the iconic mutant whose story is closely tied to trauma, telepathy and the X-Men.

item.title: Indian national arrested in Germany after allegedly strangling girlfriend in Arizona and fleeing US: Report
item.description: Investigators allege that Batchigari strangled Salazar and then took her cellphone and bank cards. He allegedly used one of Salazar’s bank cards to pay for a ride to Tucson International Airport. From Tucson, he flew to Houston and then travelled onward to Germany.

item.title: RBI governor flagged banks' margin stress, and banks see it continuing
item.description: India's banking system net interest margin was at 3.21% in June 2026, as against 3.26% a year ago, as per data by the central bank.

item.title: JPSC exam cancellation demand met, say Jharkhand protesters after talks with govt: ‘will continue stir till….’
item.description: Students protesting in Jharkhand said the government has agreed to cancel the JPSC exam while demanding a CBI probe. State officials will reportedly recommend an ED investigation into alleged financial irregularities. CM Hemant Soren emphasised dialogue over force.

item.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point Gaza plan, Netanyahu says Hamas must disarm before withdrawal
item.description: Israel has rejected Trump's 15-point Gaza plan, with PM Benjamin Netanyahu saying Israel will not withdraw until Hamas fully disarms. He also vowed to stand firm on Israel's security interests.

item.title: Phuket-Delhi flight turbulence: Air India pilot's psychoactive substance test requires confirmation, DGCA says
item.description: DGCA said the Air India pilot's initial psychoactive-substance screening after the Phuket-Delhi turbulence requires confirmatory testing. Both pilots have been removed from the roster pending the final report and investigation.

item.title: Independence day preparations at Red Fort: 20000 security personnel, over 1000 CCTVs; Inside Delhi Police's Aug 15 plan
item.description: Delhi Police announced extensive security at the Red Fort for August 15 celebrations, deploying 15,000 to 20,000 personnel, including local police and paramilitary units. Technological measures and Quick Reaction Teams (QRTs) will ensure preparedness for emergencies.

item.title: Malaysia Airlines pilot ‘distracted by laser beam,’ left disoriented before landing at Kolkata airport
item.description: The sudden laser flash affected the pilot's vision, momentarily disorienting him — Sources told PTI

item.title: Earthquake today: Magnitude 5 quake struck Alaska in United States
item.description: This is just the latest earthquake in what has been an active time for the Pacific Ring of Fire.

item.title: Jharkhand students protest day 16: CM Soren vows to deliver justice, warns of strict action against guilty— what we know
item.description: Jharkhand students protest: Addressing the Adivasi Mahotsav,CM Hemant Soren said irregularities would be investigated and those found responsible would face strict action. He maintained that the students’ movement should not be given a political colour.

item.title: 'Screening results not shared with us': Air India on pilot dope test reports after Phuket-Delhi flight turbulence
item.description: Air India said it has not received the results of a post-flight drug screening of pilots after the turbulence-hit Phuket-Delhi flight. The Federation of Indian Pilots urged caution until the findings are confirmed.

item.title: Bengaluru woman rants about sky-rocketing rents, hefty deposits — ‘Not everybody works in IT, not earning in lakhs’
item.description: One frustrated Bengaluru resident said she drops a harsh reality bomb — “Not everyone works in IT, and not everyone is making lakhs.”

item.title: Umar Khalid book event: Why JNU cancelled Aug 10 auditorium booking? Students' union says 'suppressing' critical thought
item.description: Umar Khalid book event: The event, organised by the JNUSU to mark the International Day of the World’s Indigenous Peoples, was scheduled for 3 pm on Monday at the SSS-I auditorium. It was centred on a book exploring Adivasi histories and the dynamics of power and politics.

item.title: Who is Juan Antonio March Pujol? Spain's India envoy faces allegations over financial dealings
item.description: Spain's ambassador to India Juan Antonio March Pujol is set to be replaced amid allegations over embassy funds and financial dealings linked to cultural events. Spanish authorities have reportedly referred the matter to an anti-corruption body.

item.title: ‘Portray him as…a rapist’: Tarun Tejpal’s daughter alleges political targeting
item.description: Cara Tejpal said she had initially been “terrified of speaking the truth” when her father was arrested and was deeply affected by the media coverage

item.title: Delhi Metro records 99.95% train punctuality in 2026, beats Hong Kong, Paris, New York transit systems
item.description: Delhi Metro achieved 99.95% punctuality in 2026, outperforming global transit systems. Rated among the top five worldwide, DMRC has grown significantly since its inception in 2002.

item.title: Trainer aircraft crashes near Baramati airstrip in Maharashtra, 7 months after accident that killed Ajit Pawar
item.description: A trainer aircraft crashed near Maharashtra's Baramati airstrip on Sunday, injuring two occupants. The incident occurred seven months after Ajit Pawar was killed in a crash at the same airstrip.

item.title: Delays, paper leaks and years of waiting: Jharkhand protesters tell what's really behind hunger strike
item.description: What's really behind the hunger strike at Jharkhand protest Students and job aspirants spoke about how they dealt with irregularities in recruitment exams and struggled to secure a government job, only to find it all in vain.
